component: DVS128 Gesture event parsing and frame integration
historical_scope: The archived notebook names SpikingJelly but does not record a revision. Release 0.0.0.0.14 is the verified compatibility and license reference for the distributed adapter; it is not asserted to be the original notebook revision.
function_hash_definition: SHA256 of ast.get_source_segment for each function, encoded as UTF-8 with LF line endings; includes that function docstring.
local_changes: Parser: vectorized packet decoding, explicit little-endian integers, int64 output arrays, only eight-byte polarity events retained, truncated packet-header guard.
Frame accumulation: float32 output instead of the upstream default float64; equivalent integer event counts before clipping for the dataset.
Segment indices: empty-input guard, minimum unit interval/count, clipping event-count boundaries, and leaving empty time-bin boundaries at zero.
The final time-bin right boundary is set to the number of events even if that bin is empty; this archived behavior is deliberately preserved and regression-tested.
Dataset assembly: 128-to-64 coordinate mapping, 64 frames, count clipping to uint8, official train/test lists and labels, and the archived stratified validation split.

validation.optional_dependency: Source-comparison tests require spikingjelly==0.0.0.0.14; they skip explicitly if it is absent. The parser is loaded by AST to avoid importing unrelated optional GPU and plotting dependencies.
validation.scope: Packet decoding, frame accumulation and regular nonempty time/count boundaries are compared to the exact hashed upstream source. Archived empty-bin behavior is checked separately and is not claimed to match upstream.
validation.full_dataset_verification: See data/manifests/datasets.json; source compatibility tests do not replace full raw-data verification.
